summary: Academia EduNet Fase 2 - Portal read-only view fully tested. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: login, sidebar navigation to Academia, 2-column layout with categories and videos, video player modal with YouTube embed and autoplay, search functionality, and NO create/edit/delete buttons present (read-only).

Backend: GET /api/academia/portal/categories - excludes empty categories (no published videos)
Backend: GET /api/academia/portal/videos - returns only published videos
Backend: GET /api/academia/portal/videos - enriched with category_name and subcategory_name
Backend: GET /api/academia/portal/videos?search=rick - search across video titles works
Backend: GET /api/academia/portal/videos?category_id=X - filter by category works
Backend: GET /api/academia/portal/videos/{id} - returns single published video detail
Backend: Portal endpoints require authentication (401/403 without token)
Backend: Portal accessible by school admin (role=admin)
Backend: Portal returns 403 for non-school users (support without school context)
Backend: Portal has no POST endpoints (read-only)
Backend: Portal has no PUT endpoints (read-only)
Backend: Portal has no DELETE endpoints (read-only)
Frontend: Login as admin@elroble.edu works
Frontend: Sidebar shows 'Academia' link with Video icon
Frontend: Click sidebar Academia navigates to /elroble/academia
Frontend: Academia portal page loads with data-testid='academia-portal-page'
Frontend: 2-column layout - categories panel on left, videos grid on right

Frontend: Category 'Primeros pasos' displayed with video count badge

Portal videos endpoint enriches response with category_name and subcategory_name

context_for_next_testing_agent: Academia Portal (Phase 2) fully implemented and tested. Key portal endpoints: GET /api/academia/portal/stats, GET /api/academia/portal/categories, GET /api/academia/portal/videos, GET /api/academia/portal/videos/{id}. All endpoints are read-only and require school user authentication (owner, admin, director, coordinator, teacher). Frontend: AcademiaPortalPage.jsx with VideoPlayerModal. Sidebar has 'Academia' link. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_academia_portal.py for regression testing.
